goal: FG-317: moving to target only for what the target changes; target_findings case unchanged_copy_breakage, known-bad unchanged_subject_downgraded

components.summary: Keeps one target and checks component parent design, merged code and tests.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target without executing models or code checks; reject a retired design marker in a current model as an error while preserving the existing target marker rejection; keep component_parent_unknown, component_parent_cycle and component_parent_layer as target design errors

check the current tree with the target applied using native static checks and fresh model proofs with bound tests; separate design errors from code and test work; write no project files or caches; keep entrypoint_owner findings as design errors; keep independently missing implementation anchors as code to-do when target-declared component containment is valid, with genuine regression coverage for the current and invalid-parent boundaries; retain runner_model retirement errors as errors rather than code to-do
identify exact current component, model and flow findings covered by the target; preserve unplanned failures and expose the same static target checks without model execution

promote a target after one complete check and unchanged checked inputs, writing its prepared map and model bytes, leaving changed components draft, and reporting partial I/O failures without automatic recovery
stop a target that silently drops an entrypoint, state or side effect
show invariant_untested as a model warning while retaining proof and known-bad failures
report a responsibility that loses its owner
refuse a target that changes nothing
tie a changed promise to a model rule
mark only the breakage of a changed subject as moving to target
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check
